verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) documents webhook message events covering send, delivered, hard/soft-bounce, open, click, spam, unsub and reject, with a test-and-debug section [docs-18, docs-28, docs-29], and Mailchimp's webhook guide includes a 'Verifying webhook signatures' section [docs-31]. However, the Marketing API webhooks only cover subscription changes, email changes and campaign sending, not opens or clicks, and they require a Standard or Premium plan [docs-19, docs-20]. Missing for 10: evidence that the signature scheme explicitly covers Transactional event payloads (the signature heading sits on the Marketing guide), detailed payload schema/signature algorithm documentation, open/click events on the Marketing (campaign) side, independent or hands-on corroboration.
